name: infraon-itsm
label: Infraon ITSM
description: Infraon ITSM is a cloud-ready, AI-powered IT Service Management (ITSM) platform that helps organizations manage, automate, and optimize their entire IT support and service lifecycle — from service requests and incidents to problems, changes, and compliance.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server_url
fields.tooltip: URL of the Infraon ITSM server to which you will connect and perform automated operations. Example: https://api.infraon.app
fields.description: URL of the Infraon ITSM server to which you will connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Username
fields.name: username
fields.tooltip: Username or Email Address of the Infraon user account to connect and perform the automated operations. Example: admin@example.com
fields.description: Username or Email Address of the Infraon user account to connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Password
fields.name: password
fields.tooltip: Password the Infraon ITSM server to connect and perform the automated operations.
fields.description: Password the Infraon ITSM server to connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set to True.
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set to True.

operations.title: Create Incident
operations.description: Creates a new incident on the server based on the specified summary, requester email, description, and other input parameters that you have specified.

parameters.title: Summary
parameters.description: Specify a concise incident title when creating an incident in Infraon ITSM.
parameters.name: summary
parameters.tooltip: Specify a concise incident title when creating an incident in Infraon ITSM.

parameters.title: Requester Email
parameters.description: Specify the email address of the requester who is reporting the incident.
parameters.name: requester_email
parameters.tooltip: Specify the email address of the requester who is reporting the incident. Example: user@example.com

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Provide a detailed description of the issue, including symptoms, error messages, and any relevant context.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Provide a detailed description of the issue, including symptoms, error messages, and any relevant context.

parameters.title: Team
parameters.description: Specify the Infraon team responsible for handling this incident.
parameters.name: team_name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Infraon team responsible for handling this incident.

parameters.title: Assignee Email
parameters.description: Specify the email address of the user to whom the incident should be assigned.
parameters.name: assignee_email
parameters.tooltip: Specify the email address of the user to whom the incident should be assigned.

parameters.title: Urgency
parameters.description: Indicate how urgently the incident needs to be addressed. Possible values are High, Medium, or Low.
parameters.name: urgency
parameters.tooltip: Indicate how urgently the incident needs to be addressed. Possible values are High, Medium, or Low.

parameters.title: Priority
parameters.description: Specify the priority level of the incident based on business importance. Possible values are Critical, High, Medium, Low or Very Low.
parameters.name: priority
parameters.tooltip: Specify the priority level of the incident based on business importance. Possible values are Critical, High, Medium, Low or Very Low.

parameters.title: Impact
parameters.description: Describe the impact scope of the incident on users or systems. Possible values are Business, Location, Department, Group, or User.
parameters.name: impact
parameters.tooltip: Describe the impact scope of the incident on users or systems. Possible values are Business, Location, Department, Group, or User.

parameters.title: Status
parameters.description: Specify the current workflow status of the incident.
parameters.name: status
parameters.tooltip: Specify the current workflow status of the incident.

parameters.title: Severity
parameters.description: Specify the severity level indicating how serious the incident is.
parameters.name: severity
parameters.tooltip: Specify the severity level indicating how serious the incident is.

parameters.title: Other Fields
parameters.description: Specify any additional custom fields required for incident creation as a JSON object.
parameters.name: other_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify any additional custom fields required for incident creation as a JSON object.

operations.title: Get Incident Details
operations.description: Retrieves complete details of an incident from the Infraon API based on the incident's unique ID that you have specified.

parameters.title: Ticket ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique internal Infraon incident identifier for which detailed information needs to be retrieved.
parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique internal Infraon incident identifier for which detailed information needs to be retrieved.

operations.title: Get All Incident Details
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all incidents based on the pagination and filtering criteria that you have specified.

parameters.title: Items Per Page
parameters.description: Specify the number of incidents to be returned per page in the paginated response.
parameters.name: items_per_page
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of incidents to be returned per page in the paginated response.

parameters.title: Page Number
parameters.description: Specify the page number of the incident list to retrieve.
parameters.name: page
parameters.tooltip: Specify the page number of the incident list to retrieve.

parameters.title: Filters
parameters.description: Provide filtering criteria to narrow down the list of incidents based on specific fields.
parameters.name: filters
parameters.tooltip: Provide filtering criteria to narrow down the list of incidents based on specific fields.

operations.title: Update Incident
operations.description: Updates an existing incident using its ticket ID and other input parameters that you have specified.

parameters.title: Ticket ID
parameters.description: Specify the Infraon display ID of an existing incident to update.
parameters.name: display_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Infraon display ID of an existing incident to update.

parameters.title: Summary
parameters.description: Specify an incident summary to update on this incident.
parameters.name: summary
parameters.tooltip: Specify an incident summary to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Specify the detailed description to update on this incident.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Specify the detailed description to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Status
parameters.description: Specify the current workflow status to update on this incident. (For example: Open, In Progress, On Hold, Resolved, Closed).
parameters.name: status
parameters.tooltip: Specify the current workflow status to update on this incident. (For example: Open, In Progress, On Hold, Resolved, Closed).

parameters.title: Urgency
parameters.description: Specify the urgency level to update on this incident. Typical values include High, Medium, or Low.
parameters.name: urgency
parameters.tooltip: Specify the urgency level to update on this incident. Typical values include High, Medium, or Low.

parameters.title: Severity
parameters.description: Specify the severity level to update on this incident.
parameters.name: severity
parameters.tooltip: Specify the severity level to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Priority
parameters.description: Specify the priority level to update on this incident. Possible values include Critical, High, Medium, Low, or Very Low.
parameters.name: priority
parameters.tooltip: Specify the priority level to update on this incident. Possible values include Critical, High, Medium, Low, or Very Low.

parameters.title: Priority Change Reason
parameters.description: Specify a justification for changes made to the priority level of the incident.
parameters.name: priority_change_reason
parameters.tooltip: Specify a justification for changes made to the priority level of the incident.

parameters.title: Team Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the assigned Infraon team to update on this incident.
parameters.name: team_name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the assigned Infraon team to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Team ID
parameters.description: Specify the Infraon team ID corresponding to the team assigned to update on this incident.
parameters.name: team_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Infraon team ID corresponding to the team assigned to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Assignee Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the assigned user to update on this incident.
parameters.name: assignee_name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the assigned user to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Assignee Profile
parameters.description: Specify the assigned profile to update on this incident. The profile defines the role or access level of the user assigned to this incident.
parameters.name: assignee_profile
parameters.tooltip: Specify the assigned profile to update on this incident. The profile defines the role or access level of the user assigned to this incident.

parameters.title: Assignee Profile ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique profile ID to update on this incident.
parameters.name: assignee_profile_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique profile ID to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Assignee Email
parameters.description: Specify the email address of the user to update on this incident.
parameters.name: assignee_email
parameters.tooltip: Specify the email address of the user to update on this incident.

parameters.title: Other Fields
parameters.description: Specify any additional or custom fields, with values in JSON format to update on this incident.
parameters.name: other_fields
parameters.tooltip: Specify any additional or custom fields, with values in JSON format to update on this incident.

operations.title: Delete Incident
operations.description: Deletes an incident using its display ID.

parameters.title: Ticket ID
parameters.description: Specify the Infraon display ID of the incident that needs to be permanently deleted.
parameters.name: display_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Infraon display ID of the incident that needs to be permanently deleted.

operations.title: Add Comment
operations.description: Adds a new comment to an existing incident.

parameters.title: Ticket ID
parameters.description: Specify the Infraon display ID of the incident on which to add the comment.
parameters.name: display_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Infraon display ID of the incident on which to add the comment.

parameters.title: Comment Text
parameters.description: Specify text to add to the comment.
parameters.name: comment
parameters.tooltip: Specify text to add to the comment.

operations.title: Add Attachment
operations.description: Attaches a file from FortiSOAR to an existing Infraon ITSM ticket.

parameters.title: Ticket ID
parameters.description: Specify the Infraon display ID of the incident to which the file should be attached.
parameters.name: display_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Infraon display ID of the incident to which the file should be attached.

parameters.title: Issue Key
parameters.description: Specify the Infraon issue key of the incident to which the file should be attached.
parameters.name: issue_key
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Infraon issue key of the incident to which the file should be attached.

parameters.name: path
parameters.title: Type
parameters.description: Select the type of file to submit to Infraon for analysis. The file type can be an Attachment ID or a File IRI.
parameters.tooltip: Select the type of file to submit to Infraon for analysis. The file type can be an Attachment ID or a File IRI.

parameters.name: value
parameters.title: Reference ID
parameters.description: Specify the reference ID to access the attachment metadata from the FortiSOAR Attachments module. In the playbook, this defaults to the {{vars.attachment_id}} value or the {{vars.file_iri}} value.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the reference ID to access the attachment metadata from the FortiSOAR Attachments module. In the playbook, this defaults to the {{vars.attachment_id}} value or the {{vars.file_iri}} value.
